articles.title: GHSA: Russh: Channel-scoped server callbacks can be reached without an open channel
articles.summary:
There is a server-side channel state issue in `russh`.

After a client is authenticated, `russh` can dispatch channel-scoped handler callbacks for recipient channel IDs that were never opened or confirmed.
